DECLARE
 chk varchar2(1);
 n_disp_seq number:=0;
 n number:=0;
 dup_found varchar2(10);
 dup_count number:=0;
 dup_except exception;
BEGIN
 
:system.message_level := '10';
--commit_form;
validate(form_scope);
if not form_success then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
check_password(:banner.prog_name,chk);



 --
 dup_found:=null;
 first_record;
 Loop 
 n:=n+1;
 go_record(n);
 n_disp_seq:=:valid_hh_answers.display_seq;
 
 If :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED','NEW') then
 
 go_block('valid_hh_answers');
 first_record;
 dup_count:=0;
 Loop
 If n_disp_seq=:valid_hh_answers.display_seq then 
 dup_count:=dup_count+1;
 End If;
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 End if;
 End Loop;

 If dup_count > 1 then
 dup_found :='Y';
 raise dup_except;
 end if;

 End If;
 go_block('valid_hh_answers');
 go_record(n);
 If :system.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 null;
 End if;
 
End Loop;

 --
 commit_form;
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 end if;

 exception 
 when dup_except then 
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 If upper(sqlerrm) like 'ORA-00001%' then 
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
end;

 end if;
 
 if from_where = 'T' and term_date is not null then
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then

 -- EXPAND_ALL
 -- Starting from the ROOT node, this procedure will
 -- Expand all nodes of a tree.
 -- PARAMETERS:
 -- p_tree - Name of the Tree Control object.
 -- ---------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE expand_all ( p_tree VARCHAR2 ) IS
 n_node ftree.NODE;
 i_tree ITEM;
 v_state VARCHAR2(30);
 BEGIN
 -- Find the Tree Item
 i_tree := Find_Item(p_tree);
 
 -- Find the ROOT Node of the tree
 n_node := Ftree.Find_Tree_Node(i_tree, '');
 
 --LOOP through all of the nodes and expand each one if it is collapsed
 <<expand_tree>>
 WHILE NOT Ftree.ID_NULL(n_node) LOOP
 v_state := Ftree.Get_Tree_Node_Property(i_tree, n_node, Ftree.NODE_STATE);
 
 IF ( v_state = Ftree.COLLAPSED_NODE ) THEN 
 Ftree.Set_Tree_Node_Property(i_tree, n_node, Ftree.NODE_STATE, Ftree.EXPANDED_NODE);
 END IF;
 n_node := Ftree.Find_Tree_Node(i_tree, '', Ftree.Find_Next, Ftree.NODE_LABEL, '',n_node);
 END LOOP expand_tree;
 END expand_all;

 -- FIND_NODE
 -- Called by a User defined button to search the 
 -- tree for a value. If a value is in the tree more than once,
 -- calling the FIND_NODE a subsequent time will find the next 
 -- occurance of the value specified in P_VALUE.
 -- Parameters:
 -- p_value - the value you are searching for
 -- p_start_node - defaults to 0 (zero). If specified,
 -- the search will begin at this node
 -- location, else it starts at the ROOT node.
 -- -------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE find_node (p_value VARCHAR2, p_start_node NUMBER DEFAULT 0) IS
 htree ITEM;
 found_node FTREE.node;
 BEGIN
 htree := Find_Item(Tree_Control.v_item_name);
 IF ( p_start_node = 0 ) THEN
 found_node := Ftree.Find_Tree_Node(htree
 ,p_value
 ,Ftree.FIND_NEXT
 ,Ftree.NODE_LABEL
 ,Ftree.ROOT_NODE
 ,Ftree.ROOT_NODE);
 ELSE
 found_node := Ftree.Find_Tree_Node(htree
 ,p_value
 ,Ftree.FIND_NEXT
 ,Ftree.NODE_LABEL
 ,Ftree.ROOT_NODE
 ,p_start_node);
 END IF;
 
 IF ( NOT Ftree.ID_NULL(found_node) ) THEN 
 Clear_Message;
 Message('Value: "'||p_value||'" found');
 n_curr_node := found_node;
 Ftree.Set_Tree_Selection(htree, found_node, Ftree.SELECT_ON);
 ELSE
 Clear_Message;
 Message('Value: "'||p_value||'" not found. Please try again.');
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 Clear_Message;
 Message('Value: "'||p_value||'" not found. Please try again.');
 Message(' ');
 END Find_Node;

 -- FIND_NODE
 -- Called by a User defined button to search the 
 -- tree for a value. If a value is in the tree more than once,
 -- calling the FIND_NODE a subsequent time will find the next 
 -- occurance of the value specified in P_VALUE.
 -- Parameters:
 -- p_value - the value you are searching for
 -- p_start_node - defaults to 0 (zero). If specified,
 -- the search will begin at this node
 -- location, else it starts at the ROOT node.
 -- -------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE CASE_SENS_FIND_NODE(p_value VARCHAR2, p_start_node NUMBER DEFAULT 0) IS
 htree ITEM;
 n_node FTREE.NODE;
 v_value VARCHAR2(256);
 v_label VARCHAR2(61);
 n_node_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 b_found BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 n_found_node NUMBER := 0;
 BEGIN
 htree := Find_Item(Tree_Control.v_item_name);
 
 -- <<TO DO>>
 -- uSE: IF ( p_start_node = 0 ) THEN
 -- continue search....
 
 -- Get the total number of nodes in the tree.
 n_node_cnt := Ftree.Get_Tree_Property(htree, Ftree.NODE_COUNT);

 -- Loop through all values in a Tree
 FOR i IN 0..n_node_cnt LOOP
 IF ( i != 0 ) THEN 
 v_value := Ftree.Get_Tree_Node_Property(htree, i, Ftree.NODE_VALUE);
 v_label := Ftree.Get_Tree_Node_Property(htree, i, Ftree.NODE_LABEL);
 
 -- Test if the Value matches...
 IF ( UPPER(p_value) = UPPER(v_label) ) THEN 
 Ftree.Set_Tree_Selection(htree, i, Ftree.SELECT_ON);

 b_found := TRUE;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 
 IF ( b_found ) THEN 
 Clear_Message;
 Message('Found: '||p_value);
 ELSE
 Clear_Message;
 Message('Value: '||p_value||' not found.');
 END IF; 
 END CASE_SENS_FIND_NODE;
